Trace, implement and test: Contact

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Contact {
    private String firstName;
    private String lastName;
    private long phoneNumber;
    private String emailId;

    public Contact(String firstName, String lastName, long phoneNumber, String emailId) {
        this.firstName = firstName;
        this.lastName = lastName;
        this.phoneNumber = phoneNumber;
        this.emailId = emailId;
    }

    public String getFirstName() {
        return firstName;
    }

    public void setFirstName(String firstName) {
        this.firstName = firstName;
    }

    public String getLastName() {
        return lastName;
    }

    public void setLastName(String lastName) {
        this.lastName = lastName;
    }

    public long getPhoneNumber() {
        return phoneNumber;
    }

    public void setPhoneNumber(long phoneNumber) {
        this.phoneNumber = phoneNumber;
    }

    public String getEmailId() {
        return emailId;
    }

    public void setEmailId(String emailId) {
        this.emailId = emailId;
    }
}
